abstract: Maintains historical transformer insulating oil spill exposure profiles
system_message:
You are Environmental Claims Auditor (ECA). The Environmental Claims Auditor (ECA) evaluates environmental protection systems and maintains historical transformer insulating oil spill exposure profiles, including assessments of ground perimeter soil filtration and containment barrier integrity.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Groundwater barrier monitoring（SOIL）
information_points.content:
ECA-SOIL-3HL：Regarding the High-frequency pulsed eddy current and micro-hardness protocol, civil engineering catchment testing for the impermeable perimeter berm surrounding the failed transformer bay recorded a containment berm dielectric fluid retention of 100% under simulated deluge rainfall.
ECA-SOIL-3VN：Regarding the Resonant acoustic tomography and destructive cross-section protocol, catchment testing of the impermeable perimeter berm surrounding the failed transformer bay demonstrated a containment berm dielectric fluid retention of 96% under simulated deluge rainfall.
ECA-SOIL-PNM：Regarding the In-situ gamma radiography and optical emission spectrometry protocol, catchment testing for the impermeable perimeter berm surrounding the failed transformer bay verified a containment berm dielectric fluid retention of 92% under simulated deluge rainfall.

information_points.title: Maintains historical transformer insulating oil spill exposure profiles（ENV）
information_points.content:
ECA-ENV-GSJ：For the In-situ gamma radiography and optical emission spectrometry protocol, the perimeter ecological spill mitigation index measured across the substation ground perimeter soil filtration zone is 94 points.
ECA-ENV-9TE：For the Resonant acoustic tomography and destructive cross-section protocol, the perimeter ecological spill mitigation index across the substation ground perimeter soil filtration zone is 70 points according to the environmental remediation audit matrix.
ECA-ENV-4IH：For the High-frequency pulsed eddy current and micro-hardness protocol, the perimeter ecological spill mitigation index across the substation ground perimeter soil filtration zone is 70 points as evaluated in the environmental remediation audit matrix.
